recognize_zh: 淋巴結H&E切片中，被膜下方的被膜下竇被大量大型、細胞質豐富且核仁明顯的腫瘤細胞填滿，呈竇內浸潤，是間變性大細胞淋巴瘤常見的分布模式。
features: Lymph node capsule and perinodal loose connective tissue at top
Subcapsular sinus distended by sheets of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large vesicular nuclei with visible nucleoli, including irregular and reniform forms
Admixed smaller dark lymphocytes, more numerous toward the deeper node
Cohesive-appearing sinusoidal growth that mimics metastatic carcinoma
describe_en: Lymph node section shows the capsule with an expanded subcapsular sinus filled by sheets of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes. The sinusoidal distribution and cohesive appearance mimic metastatic carcinoma. High-power nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of anaplastic large cell lymphoma with sinusoidal involvement; CD30, ALK, and keratin immunostains are recommended.

ddx.vs: Metastases also favor subcapsular sinuses but are keratin or SOX10/S100 positive and CD30 negative.
Sinus histiocytes have bland small oval nuclei and pale foamy cytoplasm without nucleolar atypia, and are CD68/CD163 positive.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets of large cells within sinuses.
